Senses.Explanation: Ananda is deployed in the Chan record as a named participant in public questions, teaching-seat actions, compilation, and lineage succession. He asks Kashyapa what was transmitted besides the gold-thread robe; Kashyapa calls ‘Ananda,’ Ananda answers, and Kashyapa tells him to knock down the flagpole before the gate. Later masters raise that exchange and question the assembly about it. In a bowl case, Ananda asks the procedure of the seven buddhas, answers the Buddha's name-call, and is told to carry the bowl and go. Elsewhere he strikes the sounding block and asks the World-Honored One to speak, questions the Buddha about an outsider's realization after a silent exchange, is said to compile the sacred words with the opening ‘Thus have I heard,’ and entrusts the eye-treasury of the teaching. These are the Zen record's deployments of Ananda, not a general hagiography.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X80/X80n1565.xml). Five Lamps Compendium (五燈會元). Ananda asks Kashyapa the succession question, answers Kashyapa's name-call, and is told to knock down the gate-front flagpole.

Occurrences.Kwic: 舉阿難問迦葉：世尊傳金襴外，別傳何法？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X79/X79n1559.xml). Jiatai Universal Lamp Record (嘉泰普燈錄). Caotang Shanqing publicly raises Ananda's robe-and-flagpole exchange as a case.

Occurrences.Kwic: 阿難曰。佛是三界大師。豈有入地獄分。曰。佛既無入地獄分。我豈有出地獄分。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X80/X80n1565.xml). Five Lamps Compendium (五燈會元). Because Devadatta slandered the Buddha and entered hell alive, the Buddha sends Ananda to ask whether he is at ease; told that he will come out when the World-Honored One comes, Ananda objects that the Buddha, the great teacher of the three realms, can have no portion in hell.

Occurrences.Kwic: 及外道去後。阿難問佛。外道有何所證。而言得入。世尊云。如世良馬。見鞭影而行。

Occurrences.Kwic: 阿難尊者坐石悟道，結集聖言，一唱我聞，三疑頓息。大事既辦，將求宗嗣
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X78/X78n1556.xml). Jianzhong Jingguo Continued Lamp Record (建中靖國續燈錄). Compiled by Foguo Weibai (佛國禪師惟白), defines Ananda's lineage position through awakening on the stone, compiling the sacred words with ‘Thus have I heard,’ and seeking a successor. Foguo Weibai is source-attested and awaits the deferred roster review.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師示眾云：「迦葉傳與阿難，且道達磨傳與什麼人？」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J24/J24nB137.xml). Recorded Sayings of Zhaozhou (趙州和尚語錄). Zhaozhou Congshen (趙州) addresses the assembly: if Kasyapa transmitted the teaching to Ananda (阿難), then to whom did Bodhidharma (達磨) transmit it?
